verdict.rationale: Supabase offers some least-privilege paths for agents. The publishable key only reaches what RLS allows, and the secret key is kept for trusted server contexts. The MCP connection can be narrowed to one project, read-only Postgres execution, and selected tool groups. However, the credential an agent actually uses for management/MCP in CI (a PAT) cannot be scoped: the docs say all scopes are required, and fine-grained scopes are only promised "in the future." Missing for 10: fine-grained scoped PATs or agent-specific tokens, credential-level (rather than URL-parameter) enforcement of read-only and project scope, and independent hands-on corroboration.
